name: The BloodRiver Saga: Retransmitter
source:
Everyone is used to the fact, that Izuku Midoriya is a typical “true hero” that would do a lot for peace and safety of others. But what if the story had turned out to be completely different from the very start? In the reality, where there wouldn’t be a hero №1, that gifted him his powers, but a cold, unscrupulous man, that counts on the fact that the main hero can’t simply deny him… What if we had seen a completely different Izuku – not so “ideal” and “pure”, but, at the same time, not a complete bastard that forgot what it means to be a human.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/NDFerretStudio]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
每个人都习惯了这样一个事实，绿谷出久是一位典型的“真正的英雄”，为他人的和平与安全做出了很多贡献。但如果故事从一开始就完全不同呢？在现实中，不会有一个赋予他力量的英雄一号，而是一个冷酷、不择手段的人，依赖于主角不能简单地否认他……如果我们看到一个完全不同的出久会怎么样——不那么“理想”和“纯洁”，但同时，也不是一个完全忘记了作为人类意味着什么的混蛋。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/NDFerretStudio]Patreon[/url]]
